item.title: Embers to Empowerment: The Womb Room Reopens in Govans, Expanding Community-Centered Perinatal Care After Hampden Fire
item.description: Baltimore, Maryland, Jan. 31, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- After sustaining water damage during the massive November 2025 fire at Keswick Castle in Hampden, The Womb Room, a Baltimore-based perinatal wellness center, has officially resumed in-person programming at a new temporary home inside The Accelerator Space in Govans, just 12 minutes from its former location. item.title: US government shuts down but quick resolution expected
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — The US government entered a partial shutdown Saturday as a midnight funding deadline passed without Congress approving a 2026 budget, though disruption was expected to be limited with the House set to move early next week to ratify a Senate-backed deal.The funding lapse followed a breakdown in negotiations driven by Democratic anger over the killing of two protesters in Minneapolis by federal immigration agents, which derailed talks over new money for the Department of Homelan

item.title: WATCH: Bishop to labor groups: Unite against systemic injustices
item.description: A Catholic bishop on Saturday urged labor groups to push back against “systemic injustices” faced by Filipino workers.Speaking at a labor consultative assembly in Quezon City, Bishop Gerardo Alminaza, president of Caritas Philippines said that low wages, job insecurity, unsafe working conditions, and workers’ exclusion from decision-making processes are ‘systemic injustices.’VIDEO BY ALLEN LIMOS

item.title: Policeman found dead in septic tank
item.description: A police officer, who had been missing for several days, was found dead inside a septic tank being built inside the property owned by the son of a veteran journalist early Saturday morning in Felicissima Village, Barangay Mojon, Malolos City, Bulacan. The victim was identified as Police Staff Sergeant Renato Casauay Jr., 46, married and a resident of 1026 Aldama St. Sta Barbara, Baliuag City, Bulacan.
